basic_info.description: Bathed in morning light and reimagined with careful attention to detail, this rare Marina-style home blends classic charm with high-end upgrades and modern finishes. The elegant barrel-front facade opens to a smartly redesigned interior featuring premium white oak wood flooring, an open chef's kitchen with premium appliances, and seamlessly into the dining area sitting under a large skylight, a step away from the formal living room. Tech-forward upgrades include Cat6 ethernet in every room, Lutron Caseta smart lighting, built-in speakers, a network cabinet, and readiness for both Cable and Fiber internet. A glass-enclosed staircase leads to a spacious lower-level primary suite with a luxe bath, walk-in shower, and direct access to a serene, low-maintenance garden. An additional flexible-use room features custom built-insideal as an office, craft room, or guest space. Both main-level bedrooms enjoy western city views and glorious sunset light. Additional upgrades include newer windows, roof, heating systems, extensively upgraded bathrooms, water filtration, custom blinds, and a level lot with rare east-west exposure. Just one block to McLaren Park, Gleneagles golf course, public transit, and quick freeway accessthis is elevated Excelsior living at its finest.
